notes.title: 1.10 Hot Fix
notes.content:
[u][b]Dungeon Adjustments:
[/b][/u]

Fixed a possible light radius bug that can occur in the
Khimera's Cave

[b][u]Magic Adjustments:[/u][/b]

Adjusted the cost of spells for Cybil & the Blue Wizard

[b][u]Skill Adjustments:[/u][/b]

Adjusted "Ripperoni Edge"  Accuracy is 90% instead of 100%
per attack.
[b][u]
Armor Adjustments:[/u][/b]

Fixed a bug that Robusta Bandana was producing and removed
the 5% regen rate it was giving.

[i]*The light bug should NOT occur anymore in either dungeon (Uggie Temple & Khimeras Cave).  However, if it happens please let me know. [/i]

notes.title: Version 1.10 Balance Adjustment Update
notes.content:
**Base upon feedback of players and watching various streamers play my games, the following adjustments have been made to improve the game.

Graphic Update on opening screen indicating version number difference.  Should display "Version 1.10" on the Splash and New Game screens

[u][b]Wep adjustments:[/b][/u]

Stabby Dagger - removed the extra attack,lowered attack by 5 points, but increase the crit rate to 15%. Change the description of the weapon matching this.

Variety Flail - Lowered attack by 10 points.

[u][b]Foe Adjustments:[/b][/u]

Increased Base Attack, Magical Attack, and Defense by 5 points starting with after "2nd World"

[b][u]Boss Adjustments:[/u][/b]

Increase Base Attack, Magical Attack, and Defense by 15 points Starting with "2nd World Boss"
Increased Base HP of Bosses by 20%

[i]**Note these adjustments are based upon players the NORMAL difficulty of the game.  [/i]
